write_authority: none — GrammarStore owns everything. This adds one entry path (§10.1).

offer_rule.never_in: input, textarea, contenteditable — selecting inside a field you are writing in is editing, not proposing
offer_rule.never_duplicate: a phrase already proposed, shared or retired is not re-offered; the reason names which state

failure_modes: no grammar store -> propose() throws; health() reports 'no-grammar-store'
phrase already exists -> not offered, reason names the existing state and id
onPropose throws -> named in console, the proposal still lands
invariants: §1.1 STILL NOT AUTOMATIC — a person selects and presses a button. Nothing reads frequency, nothing suggests candidates, health().inferred is structurally 0.
a selection can never make a term shared — propose() lands in `proposed`, and only the other side's takeUp() promotes it
the affordance NEVER steals focus: mousedown default is prevented, no modal, no scroll, no caret move
dismissed by Escape, by scrolling, or by changing the selection
§17.5 origin is recorded as 'selection', so provenance is traceable

§12.5 the noise is MEASURED: shownButIgnored and offerRate are reported, and status flips to 'noisy — tighten the rule' when offers outrun actions. An affordance that fires when nobody wanted it is a bug, not a discovery feature.
status: implemented — 17/17 in test/select-grammar.test.mjs. Suite 186/186 + lints. DOM positioning and the selectionchange handler need a real-browser pass; the offer rule, which is where the noise question is decided, is fully tested.
